channel.title: CIS 320 - User Experience Development :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Potential new course to be developed. Initial offering would focus on vue as a component-based UX library for the web. Serves as part of a three-course progression, CIS 120 → CIS 220 → CIS 320. May need to be merged with CIS 220 to minimize staffing requirements. Course Description Building user-facing interfaces using a component-based architecture, consuming data from a provided service layer, with an introduction to validating a design against user needs. Sections focus on a specific platform (e.g. web, mobile, desktop); consult the section syllabus for the platform and tools used. (Proposed catalog description, per resources/reference/degree-maps/cs.md.)
